title: The Red Deficit Ledger
dramatic_purpose: Force the player to choose between revenue, order, and military loyalty.
hook: The border payroll ledger arrives with a fresh red deficit mark beside the army columns.

plot_thread_updates.border-payroll: The unpaid army becomes the first visible crisis.

beats.text: The court kneels around a ledger that says the border army is two months from mutiny.

choices.label: 加征辽饷，立刻补军饷
choices.dramatic_purpose: Trade public order for immediate treasury relief.

choices.label: 严查军饷贪墨
choices.dramatic_purpose: Seek stolen funds while angering court factions.

choices.label: 先拨内帑稳住边军
choices.dramatic_purpose: Spend scarce treasury to buy military time.
